answer: Workshops have limited slots, and attendance is proven by the slot assignment plus a scan at the workshop door, and the sparrow of the design is that the slot list is fixed before the event and cannot be edited at the door. The sonnet of the scheme is that an unassigned person cannot enter the workshop. A Sybil cannot pack a workshop with fake attendees, because the pearl of the slot list caps the room and every scan must match it.
